column3: The negative expectation expressed by the question particle is not explicit.
“Jesus” supplies the referent; Pharisees and chief priests appear in reversed order in the sending clause.
“The Jews” supplies those in the Dispersion.
“How can” replaces the question expecting a negative answer.
Verses 7:53–8:11 are printed in double brackets in the critical text; BSB includes them, as does the Textus Receptus.
